local function getCharacterParts(): {[BasePart]: boolean}
	local parts: {[BasePart]: boolean} = {}
	local character = player.Character
	if character then
		for _, descendant in character:GetDescendants() do
			if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
				parts[descendant] = true
			end
		end
	end
	return parts
end

local function onInput(inputObject: InputObject, gameProcessed: boolean)
	if gameProcessed then
		return
	end
	if inputObject.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
		return
	end

	local ignore = getCharacterParts()
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { player.Character :: Instance }
	params.IgnoreWater = false

	local origin = camera.CFrame.Position
	local direction = camera.CFrame.LookVector * MAX_DISTANCE

	local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, params)
	if result then
		local part = result.Instance
		if not ignore[part] then
			print(`Looking at: {part.Name}`)
		end
	end
end

	Sword = {
		Price = SWORD_PRICE,
		ToolName = "Sword",
	},

local buyItemEvent = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("BuyItem")
if not buyItemEvent then
	buyItemEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	buyItemEvent.Name = "BuyItem"
	buyItemEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end
local BuyItem = buyItemEvent :: RemoteEvent

local function getCoins(player: Player): IntValue?
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not leaderstats then
		return nil
	end
	return leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins") :: IntValue?
end

local function hasItem(player: Player, itemName: string): boolean
	local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	if backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild(itemName) then
		return true
	end
	if player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild(itemName) then
		return true
	end
	return false
end

BuyItem.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, itemName: unknown)
	if typeof(itemName) ~= "string" then
		return
	end

	local item = ITEMS[itemName]
	if not item then
		return
	end

	if hasItem(player, item.ToolName) then
		return
	end

	local coinsValue = getCoins(player)
	if not coinsValue then
		return
	end

	local currentCoins = coinsValue.Value
	if currentCoins < item.Price then
		return
	end

	coinsValue.Value = currentCoins - item.Price

	local tool = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild(item.ToolName)
	if tool and tool:IsA("Tool") then
		tool:Clone().Parent = player.Backpack
	else
		-- Refund if we couldn't deliver the item
		coinsValue.Value = currentCoins
	end
end)

local MAX_NAME_LENGTH = 24
local MIN_NAME_LENGTH = 2

local function sanitizeName(player: Player, newName: string): string?
	newName = newName:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") -- trim whitespace
	if #newName < MIN_NAME_LENGTH or #newName > MAX_NAME_LENGTH then
		return nil
	end
	-- Player-authored text shown to other players must be filtered

		return TextService:FilterStringAsync(newName, player.UserId)
	end)
	if not ok then
		return nil
	end
	local filtered
	ok, filtered = pcall(function()
		return result:GetNonChatStringForBroadcastAsync()
	end)
	if not ok then
		return nil
	end
	return filtered
end

local function onPlayerAdded(player: Player)
	local petName = Instance.new("StringValue")
	petName.Name = "PetName"
	petName.Value = player.Name .. "'s Pet"
	petName.Parent = player

	if typeof(newName) ~= "string" then

	local petName = player:FindFirstChild("PetName")
	if not petName then

	-- simple rate limit: ignore renames fired more than once per 5 seconds
	local lastRename = petName:GetAttribute("LastRename") or 0
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - lastRename < 5 then

	if not filtered then

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local playerDataStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")

local MAX_RETRIES = 3
local RETRY_DELAY = 2

local function saveCoins(player: Player)
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not leaderstats then
		return
	end

	local coinsValue = leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
	if not coinsValue or not coinsValue:IsA("IntValue") then
		return
	end

	local coins = coinsValue.Value
	local key = "Player_" .. player.UserId

	local success = false
	for attempt = 1, MAX_RETRIES do
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			playerDataStore:UpdateAsync(key, function(oldValue)
				-- Read the CURRENT stored value so we never clobber another server's write
				local newTable
				if type(oldValue) == "table" then
					newTable = table.clone(oldValue)
					newTable.Coins = coins
				else
					newTable = { Coins = coins }
				end
				return newTable
			end)
		end)

		if ok then
			success = true
			break
		end

		warn(string.format("Failed to save coins for %s (attempt %d/%d): %s", player.Name, attempt, MAX_RETRIES, tostring(err)))
		if attempt < MAX_RETRIES then
			task.wait(RETRY_DELAY)
		end
	end

	if not success then
		warn(string.format("Could not save coins for %s after %d attempts; coins unsaved this session.", player.Name, MAX_RETRIES))
	end
end

--!strict
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")
local MAX_RETRIES = 5
local RETRY_DELAY = 2

local loaded: {[Player]: boolean} = {}

local function retry<T>(fn: () -> T): (T?, string?)
	local lastErr
	for attempt = 1, MAX_RETRIES do
		local ok, result = pcall(fn)
		if ok then
			return result, nil
		end
		lastErr = result
		if attempt < MAX_RETRIES then
			task.wait(RETRY_DELAY * attempt)
		end
	end
	return nil, tostring(lastErr)
end

local function getLeaderCoins(player: Player): IntValue
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") :: Folder?
	local coins = (leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins")) :: IntValue?
	if not coins then
		leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
		leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
		coins = Instance.new("IntValue")
		coins.Name = "Coins"
		coins.Value = 0
		coins.Parent = leaderstats
		leaderstats.Parent = player
	end
	return coins :: IntValue
end

local function saveCoins(player: Player, coinsValue: number): boolean
	local key = "Player_" .. player.UserId
	local ok, err = retry(function()
		store:UpdateAsync(key, function(current)
			local data = current
			if typeof(data) ~= "table" then
				data = {}
			end
			data.Coins = coinsValue
			return data
		end)
	end)
	if not ok then
		warn(("Failed to save coins for %s: %s"):format(player.Name, err))
	end
	return ok
end

local function onPlayerAdded(player: Player)
	local coins = getLeaderCoins(player)
	local key = "Player_" .. player.UserId

	local data, err = retry(function()
		return store:GetAsync(key)
	end)

	if data == nil and err ~= nil then
		-- Read failed: do NOT write defaults over a key we couldn't read.
		warn(("Load failed for %s; this session will not be saved. (%s)"):format(player.Name, err))
		coins.Value = 0
		return
	end

	if typeof(data) == "table" and typeof(data.Coins) == "number" then
		coins.Value = math.floor(data.Coins)
	end

	loaded[player] = true
end

local function onPlayerRemoving(player: Player)
	if not loaded[player] then
		return -- never save a session whose load failed
	end
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local coins = leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins") :: IntValue?
	if coins then
		saveCoins(player, coins.Value)
	end
	loaded[player] = nil
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(onPlayerRemoving)

for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
	task.spawn(onPlayerAdded, player)
end

local function onShutdown()
	if RunService:IsStudio() then
		task.wait(1)
	end
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		onPlayerRemoving(player)
	end
end

game:BindToClose(onShutdown)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")
local MAX_RETRIES = 3
local RETRY_DELAY = 2

local function loadData(userId: number): (number?, boolean)
	for attempt = 1, MAX_RETRIES do
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return store:GetAsync("Player_" .. userId)
		end)
		if ok then
			return result, true
		end
		if attempt < MAX_RETRIES then
			task.wait(RETRY_DELAY)
		end
	end
	return nil, false
end

local function saveData(userId: number, coins: number): boolean
	for attempt = 1, MAX_RETRIES do
		local ok = pcall(function()
			store:UpdateAsync("Player_" .. userId, function(old)
				return coins
			end)
		end)
		if ok then
			return true
		end
		if attempt < MAX_RETRIES then
			task.wait(RETRY_DELAY)
		end
	end
	return false
end

local sessionLoaded: {[Player]: boolean} = {}

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	local coins, loaded = loadData(player.UserId)
	sessionLoaded[player] = loaded

	local leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
	leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
	leaderstats.Parent = player

	local coinsValue = Instance.new("IntValue")
	coinsValue.Name = "Coins"
	coinsValue.Value = if loaded then (coins or 0) else 0
	coinsValue.Parent = leaderstats
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	local loaded = sessionLoaded[player]
	sessionLoaded[player] = nil

	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local coinsValue = leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins")

	-- A failed load is not an empty account: never overwrite with a default.
	if not loaded then
		return
	end

	local coins = if coinsValue and coinsValue:IsA("IntValue") then coinsValue.Value else 0
	if not saveData(player.UserId, coins) then
		warn(("Failed to save coins for %s (UserId %d); data not saved this session."):format(player.Name, player.UserId))
	end
end)
